messages:
Priya: Quick Grants UX PR is up. Product wants an "undo" action available for ~30s after granting a role from the console — cc @Kevin @Anna. Do we want backend support (soft-grant) or purely client-side optimistic undo? Thoughts on telemetry and quota interactions?
Kevin: Leaning backend soft-grant + explicit finalize. Client shows immediate success with undo button. If undo clicked, call revoke using undo_token. Telemetry: tag grant.quick=true and grant.undo_used=true/false.
Anna: Implementation idea: create grant record with status="pending" and expires_at = now+30s. Finalize job flips to "active". Return undo_token to client. Simpler than trying to retroactively revoke fully-applied ACL changes.
Simon: Caveat: routing/policy evaluation reads entitlements from the auth cache (default TTL 5s). If a pending grant should be effective immediately, we must either invalidate caches or publish an entitlement.changed event. Otherwise the UI will show granted but actual routing may ignore it for a few seconds.
Priya: Good point. Proposal: emit entitlement.changed event on create + on finalize + on revoke. Consumers that rely on eventual consistency can subscribe. Also surface a small spinner in UI until routing confirms applied? Maybe too noisy.
Kevin: Another important piece: quotas. We must decide whether pending grants count towards quota (e.g., tenant resource caps). If we treat pending as active for quota checks, users can't game quick grants to exceed units. I vote treat as active for quota enforcement.
Anna: Agreed — enforce quotas immediately. For audit visibility, show "pending (undoable)" state in admin audit stream so security teams see it.
Priya: UX microcopy draft: "Quick grant — can be undone within 30s. This grant may be visible in audit logs immediately and may affect quotas. Learn more." Link to docs.
Simon: Telemetry request: include grant_source=console/button, quick_grant=true, undo_available_ttl=30, route_policy_snapshot (id/hash) and quota_snapshot at time-of-grant. That will help triage routing/quota regressions tied to quick grants.
Priya: API sketch I'll add to PR: POST /admin/grants {principal, role, ttl=30, source: "console_quick"} -> {grant_id, undo_token, status: "pending"}. POST /admin/grants/undo {undo_token} -> 200. Finalize job transitions status -> "active" after ttl unless undone.
deploy-bot: canary deploy quick-grants-ux to staging succeeded :rocket:
Anna: I'll take cache invalidation/event plumbing and audit visibility changes.
Kevin: I'll own quota semantics + tests. Will sketch interaction doc by EOD.
Priya: Awesome. I'll update the PR with the telemetry schema + UI copy. Thanks all :heart:
Simon: One minor: for enterprise tenants default quick-grants off via tenant policy allow_quick_grants=false, with a console toggle for admins.
Priya: Yep adding that to the rollout plan (off for enterprise by default, opt-in per org).
Priya: Filing follow-ups: add integration tests for entitlement event emission, add quota regression test, add docs link.
Kevin: Will post the quota doc link once ready.
Priya: Thanks, closing loop — will merge after Anna's cache changes land.
